title: Workflow bounded rerun can fall back to discovery-only artifacts when cluster runtime is sent to /api/analyze-path
symptom: Workflow bounded rerun job 13846a6c completed with only discovery artifacts (status.json, discovery_meta.json, invocables_map.json, exports_mcp.json) and emitted no explore_config, cluster_seed_plan, explore_probe_log, findings, or verification-report artifacts, so the run was not a trustworthy workflow cluster decision surface.
smallest_reproducer: POST /api/analyze-path for tests/fixtures/contoso_workflow/contoso_workflow.dll with checkpoint_id=a582e3f8, checkpoint_stage=s02_probe, cluster_checkpoint_id=workflow_reservation_open_state, and focus_functions centered on WF_GetWorkflowState
trust_impact: The workflow cluster gate cannot be judged from this run because the bounded runtime never entered the explore pipeline and therefore produced no observer-backed evidence.
allowed_next_actions: treat /api/analyze-path as discovery-only for this lane
start a fresh workflow analyze-path job and then invoke /api/jobs/{job_id}/explore with the bounded cluster runtime
inspect the resulting explore_config, cluster_seed_plan, probe log, findings, and verification report before patching workflow logic
disallowed_next_actions: launch another full Batch B run
patch workflow state logic based on a discovery-only job
start config tuning before the workflow gate is trustworthy
exit_criteria: a fresh workflow bounded rerun emits full explore-stage artifacts
the workflow cluster has observer-backed evidence for WF_GetWorkflowState
the next workflow tuning decision is based on probe and verification artifacts instead of thin discovery output
